findings.problem: Old resume accepted any whole NPZ+JSON pair with matching implementation hash and payload hash, even when arm/seed/start/stop/input rows belonged to a different block.
findings.fix: Bind arm,seed,start,stop,path,input SHA,implementation SHA plus actual source_indices,match_ids,actor_slots,technical_unsupported. Validate stable existing cell/run completion identity before accepting completed resume.

findings.problem: Runner addressed prefixes.npz while completed preparation produced test_prefixes.npz.
findings.fix: Use skillcorner_prepared/test_prefixes.npz and verify its SHA directly against prepared_prefix_sha256 before loading.
Added optional --synthetic-receipt path; original runner_synthetic.json retained byte-for-byte.

reviewed.six_paths: Order and semantics consistent with protocol. Sham changes only actor A terminal observation flag and recomputes age through original API; history values/usable masks remain unchanged.
reviewed.pairwise_support: Each contrast uses own per-time support intersection. Persistent rejection does not remove first-natural output. Sham never rescues rejected first.
reviewed.missing_and_unsupported: All-unsupported compact block retains NaN states/metrics, false support, zero completed steps and UNSUPPORTED_PREPARED status. Initial rejection stays separate from natural completion.
reviewed.CV: Original1e-4 kept. Analytic t*delta and direct/iterated paths pass existing synthetic;180 synthetic pitch/speed/headings have max4.863739013671875e-5 and0 exceedances.
reviewed.immutability: Original source hashes match frozen archive. Runner math/operator/api unchanged. Model state checked before/after each cell, implementation locks before/after run; resume additionally validates source row identity.
reviewed.resume_scope: Only complete hash-verified blocks; orphan NPZ is rejected, not overwritten. Root still controls single worker as protocol specifies.
